name: Feathers for Grazle
objectiveText: Progress While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe.  To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you. Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers.  Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw. Deadwood Headdress Feather  ( 5 )

comments.body:
This quest is only obtainable once you've done the quest "Timbermaw Ally", also given by Grazle. Along with this quest upon completion of "Timbermaw Ally", he also gives you a quest called "Speak to Nafien".

"Feathers for Grazle" is a repeatable quest, although Grazle does not appear to have the blue Question Mark above his head.

These mobs are heavily farmed, I suggest finding off peak times to grind them.  Also just killing the mobs gives you rep, so like all turn in quests for rep, hold on to the turn ins until kills don't give rep anymore.  

This way you minimize the amount of time spent grinding rep overall.

To state it clearly,  hold onto these feathers and also the beads until you hit revered.  At revered you no longer get rep from just killing and feathers and beads are the only way to increase rep.  They stack in lots of 250  (actually I'm sure the beads do but feathers may be 200, can't log in to check right now) so it doesn't take up much inventory.

Classic WoW 9/14/2019
Turned in this quest twice, you get 550 Exp and 50 Rep PER TURN IN.
If a mod can fix the exp to say 550 instead of 560 that would be great.

I am ~150 feathers from having all of them I need to get to exalted. I want to plan it out so I ding 60 and exalted at the same time!
Anyone know if you stop being able to do this turn-ins at any particular rep level?

Gives 50 Reputation points toward Timbermaw Hold

The npc to turn in these feathers is outside the cave entrance in felwood that leads to Winterspring
replies:
Quest giver Grazle now by the road closest to the southern Village. 

Also gives 550xp in addition to the rep at lvl48.

comments.body: Repeatable quest to help increase faction with the Timbermaw.  The Felwood Timbermaw drop these feathers, the Winterfell Timbermaw drop the Beads.

In my opinion,on average,even with some other alliance and horde players nearby,the spawn rate of the Overlord Ror,at the camp near grazle is between 5-10 minutes,this allows for you to attempt to kill him,then,while waiting on his spawn,grind the nearby DeadWood Furbolgs for the feathers.When it has been about 4-6 minutes,head back over to where he spawns,and kill off any spawns around there that have appeared already.Once they are gone,(for melee users) stand right between the two buildings(where they get close) and there should be a patch of flowers or mushrooms about a few inches tall,that is about a foot behind his spawn point,if you're a rogue,this is where you should stealth.And for ranged users and spellcasters,the best place to stand and wait for him is on the cliffside directly behind that patch of flowers/mushrooms.

Once he spawns,be ready to fight get a start off ability of some sort that is quick,incase other players are waiting for him to,and for those of you that will have a tough time with him(as in you are near his level) be prepared for him to fear you when his Health gets down to about half.If any other Furbolgs spawn while he is there,just try and pull him back and away,it takes them a little while to truly activate,and since he is a melee mob,it is easy to draw him.Also,he uses a mace,that can be disarmed to make the battle even easier.

Once he is killed,return to grinding the nearby mobs and repeat the process.

P.S.,the nearby mobs function like player classes,with the DeadWood Warriors=Druid Bear Form or Warrior,Deadwood Gardener=Shaman/Druid style healer,and the Pathfinder=Hunter,both the Pathfinders and Gardeners will try and cast a shadow type spell callled "Curse of the DeadWood" which all healing effects upon the victim by 50%,this includes the undead Cannabalize,so be prepared to silence or stop the casting with a class move(like rogues' Kick) if you have one.

comments.body: and the minimum rep level to start this quest and it's predecessor is _________________.
replies:
Prerequisite for this repeatable quest is [url=/quest=6131]Timbermaw Ally[/url].

Timbermaw Ally, followed by turn-ins of this quest a couple of times, should be good enough to earn players "unfriendly" status for Timbermaw Hold -- thereby enabling a safe passage through Timbermaw Hold to Winterspring/Moonglade.
